title: Honeycomb-Surfels: Compact Hexagonal Primitives for Efficient Scene Rendering and Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.37668v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction have advanced rapidly with radiance fields and splatting, yet their memory and computational demands limit their use in resource-constrained settings. We introduce Hexels: novel planar hexagonal surface elements with a first-order spatial color field for efficient 3D scene and 2D image representation. Hexels exploit locally planar regions with smoothly varying appearance using fewer, larger primitives. Their hexagonal support provides an area- and boundary-efficient domain, while the local color field captures appearance variation within each primitive. Across 34 scenes, Hexels improve PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB across datasets while requiring lower training VRAM. We further ablate Hexels by showing that per primitive, Hexels outperform 2DGS by upto 4.74 dB while using lower training VRAM and having 2.31 times faster FPS. translated_title: 蜂巢面元（Honeycomb-Surfels）：用于高效场景渲染与重建的紧凑六边形基元
translated_abstract: 新视角合成与三维重建随着辐射场和泼溅（splatting）技术迅速发展，但其内存和计算需求限制了它们在资源受限环境中的应用。我们提出了Hexels：一种新颖的平面六边形表面元素，带有用于高效3D场景和2D图像表示的一阶空间颜色场。Hexels利用更少、更大的基元来捕捉具有平滑变化外观的局部平面区域。其六边形支撑域在面积和边界上都是高效的，而局部颜色场则能够捕捉每个基元内部的外观变化。在34个场景的实验中，Hexels在与内存匹配的2DGS相比下，在多个数据集上将PSNR提升了4.53-7.38 dB，同时所需的训练显存更低。我们进一步对Hexels进行了消融实验，结果表明在单个基元层面，Hexels的性能比2DGS最高提升4.74 dB，同时使用更低的训练显存，并拥有快2.31倍的帧率（FPS）。即使在无约束的场景中，Hexels也提供了互补的……
tldr: Hexels是一种带有局部颜色场的平面六边形基元，用更少、更大的基元即可高效表示3D场景，在与内存匹配的2DGS对比中PSNR提升4.53-7.38 dB，且训练显存更低、渲染速度快2.31倍。
en_tdlr: Hexels are planar hexagonal primitives with a first-order spatial color field that enable efficient 3D scene representation, improving PSNR over memory-matched 2DGS by 4.53-7.38 dB while requiring lower training VRAM and achieving 2.31x faster rendering.
